posts.text: To be fair, maybe it was the Norwegians who pushed us into this war. Hard to tell.

Mark Levin just said he never urged the president to go to war with Iran. Are ... you ... kidding ... me? What in the world?! Is this slimeball of all slimeballs trying to get out of responsibility for starting this war? Um, no. There's no weaseling out of this one. The chutzpah!

Here's what I'm not interested in hearing later - how @JDVance and @TulsiGabbard were secretly against the war. Fuck that!! Those two have been pretending to be anti-war this whole time. You know when's a good time to be anti-war - right fucking now. Afterwards is total bullshit.

Btw, have you noticed that to this day, absolutely no one in mainstream media has asked the question - why doesn't Israel send in the gorund troops instead of us? I'm sure they would all find the suggestion that Americans don't want to die for Israel to be terribly antisemitic.

I have a unique idea to stop the war - adopt a boomer. National media is a disgusting propaganda machine that loves corruption, Israel and war. A lot of boomers on both sides are hooked on it. Everyone go find and flip a boomer to our side. They're only ones left who are pro-war.

We had an Operation Hope town hall tonight on TYT to try to fight against the war. We have these wonderful volunteers who are doing everything they can to get the country to turn around. The quicker we end the war, the more American lives we save. UnitedAgainstWar.com
HELL NO to more wars. #UnitedAgainstWar

I don't think the Senate needs another apologist for Israel's war crimes. They already have about 90. Does her attacks against both El Sayed and @hasanthehun mean that she's going to do as Israel orders her if she gets into the Senate. And if she does, how is she any different?

Why is @MalloryMcMorrow smearing her opponent as too aggressively against Israel? She's running for Michigan Senate seat against @AbdulElSayed. She's tone policing his comments about Israel's atrocities and attacking critics of Israel as antisemitic. This is no change at all.

Josh Hammer gave this hilarious speech at CPAC, where he claimed that @TuckerCarlson @megynkelly and @mtgreenee were the "retard right." And that he and Israel First represent the real right-wing that loves war and loves Donald Trump's obedience to Israel. Sure, buddy, sure.

I said a lot of people on the left were misunderstanding @joerogan and all the independent podcasters. They didn't agree with us on everything, but they weren't MAGA. Others said they were hard core MAGA extremists. 

Here's what Rogan just said about some of the people in MAGA, "a lot of them are dorks. A lot of them these really weird fucking uninteresting, unintelligent people."

The world is not black and white. Everyone who disagrees with you on a couple of issues is not your enemy.

Donald Trump is completely full of shit. If he says we're not going to hit Iran for awhile, that means we're sending in ground troops imminently. The sad thing is that he thinks he's being clever.

Vote in your own party's primaries. And vote out anyone who takes money from @AIPAC, because those candidates are promising to betray you on behalf of a foreign government's lobby. Vote out almost all the incumbents! OperationConsequences.com

Only 13% of Democratic voters have a positive view of Israel. If any Democratic politician takes money from @AIPAC, they are actively choosing to represent their donors instead of their voters. They're saying they'll represent Israel over you! You'd be nuts to vote for them.

There are no bigger racists in America than AIPAC and nothing that is more un-American. They demand that US politicians provide billions to kill innocent Arabs and Persians. They demand that our politicians serve Israel instead. Taking money from them is betraying this country.

This is the traitorous lobby AIPAC trying to tell Americans who they can and can't speak to. Israel will decide for us who is allowed to speak in American media, they say. Then this lobby pretends it has no control. Good, then you can fuck off. We don't care what you think.
